parameters.content:
PODCAST PRODUCTION ENGINE -- Skill 58
What: Dual-gate standing check that validates whether a client is authorized to publish a podcast episode. First checks the podcast_publish_roster data table for good_standing, then layers on the fleet_standing gate (good_standing + podcast_approved flags). Returns a fail-closed verdict used by create-podcast-episode-from-openclaw before publishing.
Trigger: POST /webhook/podcast-standing-check (header-authenticated, same credential as the publish gate)
Output: JSON {ok: true, good_standing: boolean, reason: string}. Also logs every verdict to the podcast_publish_ledger data table for audit.
Credentials: Podcast Publish Gate (header auth), fleetStandingCheck Header Auth (for rejection notification)
Called by: create-podcast-episode-from-openclaw (TkL0rn2SH3q32SeB) before any Podbean API calls
